---
title: "HE: Higher Education"
description: "Information about enrolments, completions, courses, and loan amounts for students studying at Australian higher education institutions."
---

Information about enrolments, completions, courses, and loan amounts for students studying at Australian higher education institutions.

*Defines the annual higher-education student collection and lists its principal variables.*
